findings.title: GodObject struct has excessive responsibilities
findings.message: God Object detected: 'GodObject' has 5 methods and 20 fields. (Thresholds: methods>5, fields>8) LCOM4 score: 1 (>1 indicates low cohesion)
findings.aiExplanation: This struct violates the Single Responsibility Principle by having too many fields and methods. It appears to be handling multiple concerns that should be separated into different classes or modules.
findings.recommendation: Consider breaking this into smaller, more focused structs. For example, separate data handling, validation, and business logic into different components.

diagrams.title: God Object Analysis
diagrams.source:
classDiagram
    class GodObject {
        +field1: String
        +field2: String
        +field3: String
        +field4: String
        +field5: String
        +massiveMethod()
        +anotherLargeMethod()
        +duplicateCode1()
        +duplicateCode2()
        +unusedMethod()
    }
    
    note for GodObject "God Object Detected\n\n• 20+ fields/methods\n• Multiple responsibilities\n• High complexity\n• Violation of SRP"
    
    GodObject --> DataLayer : manages
    GodObject --> UILayer : controls
    GodObject --> BusinessLogic : implements
    
    class DataLayer {
        +save()
        +load()
    }
    
    class UILayer {
        +render()
        +update()
    }
    
    class BusinessLogic {
        +calculate()
        +process()
    }
